description: Shared conformance corpus for the chio.process.v1 worker protocol. Normative text: spec/PROTOCOL.md section 8.6. server cases run in order, one connection each, against one fresh reference host; client cases drive each SDK client against a stub host that returns the given response bytes.

reference_host.description: One root process with id root and no preparation service. Tool server tools exposes append and read, both granted; each echoes its arguments, and arguments {"large": true} return a string of max_response_bytes characters. The host issues one credential for root and substitutes it for fixture_credential in every frame.

cases.name: invoke-operation-key-multibyte-over-byte-limit
cases.note: 129 characters pass maxLength, but 258 UTF-8 bytes exceed the 256-byte limit.

cases.name: prepare-invocation-without-host-preparer
cases.note: The reference host installs no preparation service.

cases.name: checkpoint-revision-over-u64
cases.note: Matches the decimal pattern and length bound but exceeds an unsigned 64-bit integer.

cases.name: blob-put-non-canonical-base64
cases.note: Well-formed base64 whose unused bits are set does not re-encode to the same text.

cases.name: unterminated-frame
cases.note: The client half-closes its connection without sending a newline.
